answer_1.quote: Conditional text generation tasks involve generating a sequence of tokens ŷ1 , . . . , ŷT = ŷ1:T conditioned on some x ∈ X ... We will consider in particular the task of table-to-text generation, where x is some tabular data and ŷ1:T is a natural language description of it.
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions of tabular data

answer_2.quote: We first evaluate our models and baselines using the standard automatic metrics associated with each dataset, including BLEU, NIST, ROUGE, CIDEr and METEOR, in Table.

answer_4.quote: We ask crowd-workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk to score generations in terms of their naturalness, their faithfulness to the source table, and their informativeness, on a 5-point Likert scale.
